book.name: 1 Korin
book.title: 1 KORIN KORINMBA LA NƗMBA KAT POL PƗLƗWUTA KƗTA WAN PAS

content: TAMBA LA NƗMBA KAVLE YINJA VAK KAT YELAVƗK NGWULA
Yakwa nɨmba kɨta vat vɨngwangat wowun. Tamba Moses ta njɨmbla tɨmbu yinja yambɨ ndi kat vɨsɨmogwindɨ. Nɨna ngwat walanga aywaa tɨmbu vɨgɨvaa yilɨndi.
Ndi aywaa Mosesna kwundi wuka tɨmbuna kwupmba yilɨndi. Moses wandɨ maa sak ngu mbɨlɨndɨ maa kɨpma valɨgenja njɨmbla ndi aywaa valɨgendi.
God ndi kat nyinangwutna nao kwindɨ, ndi aywaa kɨndi.
Moses kambat viyandɨ, mbɨlɨndɨ, wogweya ngu ndi aywaa kɨndi. Ndinogwinala yila nyan kambak vla lɨndɨ. Ndɨ Kraistna. Ndi kat vɨga lɨndɨ.
Ndi aywaa apma vat ana yindi. Ndina nɨma sakwat nɨmba God waa nyaangɨt wupmak kat kai wandi maa God ndi kat kai walaa kɨklindɨ. Ndi ndinyangu lapman kavamba yiga lɨga kiyandi.
Ndi kavle nda klavak yelavɨka lɨga kavle yindi. Nɨn mbambala kavle yinja vak kat vɨlaa yelavɨkiyanɨn. Kavle nda klavak yelavɨka lɨneyan nɨno kavle yigiyanɨn waa yelavɨkiyanɨn.
Ndina nat nɨmba waagan kait kat kwunaka lɨndi. Tamba la nɨmba yinja vak vɨlaa pɨlɨwutndi. Ndi nao ngu kɨlaa waagan kait kat kwunapmak mbangu veivat laatndi. Yinja vla mbaa yilanɨn.
Ndina nat nɨmba yambɨsɨk yilɨnja vak yilɨndi maa God ndi kat sɨndɨ. Sɨga 23,000 nɨmba kat sɨndɨ, kiyandi kɨta nandinyamba. Yinja vla mbaa yilanɨn.

Ndina nat nɨmba God kat wandi. Nɨn apma vat nɨn kat ana vɨga lɨgamɨn. Mɨn kwonduo lɨga nyan o kai? waa wandi. Wandi maa God wandɨ maa kavle kamboy yalaa ndi kat valɨndi, nɨma sakwat nɨmba kiyandi. Yinja vla mbaa yilanɨn.
Ndina nat nɨmba God kat njɨtɨndi, njambwi nyan ndi kat vatnyandɨ. Yinja vla mbaa yilanɨn.
Ndi kat kavle vat ya vak ndi kat mandɨp kupi maawut kwivat yandɨ. Nat nɨmba yɨlaa pɨlɨwutndi. Nɨn ngɨni la lɨga nɨmba vɨlaaa apma maawut sɨtnangat walaa pɨlɨwutndi.
Ngwutna kɨta nyan wun apma vat mɨna yiga yetɨlɨgowun. Wun ana kavle yigiyowun waa yelavɨtndeyan ana nglaatndɨ. Samat tɨga ndɨ anagandɨ kavle yigiyaa.

Ngwuk kat yalɨga kavle vat ngwuk kat mɨna ana yalɨgandɨ. Yandɨ ma nɨmamba ke yelavɨka lɨngwa. God ngwutna lak kwaigandɨ. Ngwuk kat kwulakiya kavle vat kat God kai wandɨ, ngwuk kat ana yaa kwulaiyandɨ. Ngwuk kat ava kwondu kwindɨ maa ngwuk wan yaiga kavle vak kat kwulakiyangwuk.
GOD KAT YELAVƗKA YETƗGA LƗGA WAAGAN KAT ANA KWUNAKIYANƗN
Wuna mbaapma nɨmba waagan kait kat kwunatɨnja vak ke yingwa. Wan kavle vatna.
Ngwula maawut tamba sɨka lɨgangwuk. Ngi kat tɨga wawa nyaangɨt wutaa kwutaa yetɨgiyangwuk. Ngwuk avla yelavɨka sɨga naguga kwutaa lɨgiyangwuk.

Yetɨlɨna vak kat yelavɨk ngwula. Nɨn njɨmbla njɨmbla ngu lɨga kap kwutaa Kraist nɨn kat tɨga kiyandɨ waa yelavɨka kɨlɨganɨn. Kraist kiyandɨ maa ndɨna yelagwen kɨpmamba ndandɨ nɨn kat kwunapmak wan yelavɨka kɨlɨganɨn. Ngwuk bret-nao kɨta kwutaa samat samat lɨmbaga kwutaa Kraist nɨn kat tɨga kiyandɨ waa yelavɨka kɨlɨganɨn. Kraist nɨn kat kwunapmak kiyandɨ waa yelavɨtnɨn mala Kraist nɨn kat kwunakiyandɨ. Nɨn aywaa ndɨna kɨta mbaapma nɨmba lɨganɨn.
Nɨn kɨtamba yisolaa bret-nao kɨta lɨmbaga kɨtamba kɨlɨganɨn. Ngi kat tɨga nɨn aywaa ndɨna kɨta mbaapma nɨmba lɨganɨn.
Tamba la Juda wungivat sɨgɨt ndino tɨndi. God kat kwunapmak kat kwinja wɨmbu ka nɨmba ndi aywaa kɨta mbaapma nɨmba lɨndi. Ndi kɨta vat yelavɨka kilɨndi.

Anda vapmba yelavɨkngwangat wan nyaangɨt mbutɨgowun. Wuna nyaangɨt wutaa waagan kaik kat mbaa vaatangwuk. Waagan kait kat kwinja nda kat mbaa vaatangwuk. Wan nda nɨma nda ana ndɨ. Kɨta nda yelavɨkngwangat walɨgowun. Wan nda kɨngiyandɨ. Nat kavle nɨmba waagan kaik kat yelavɨka waagan kat kwunaka yetɨnjeyan nɨma nyan kat ana yelavɨka yetɨgiyandi. Ndi kɨpma lɨga mat nɨmba kat mɨna yelavɨka kwunatɨgandi. Ngwuk mbaa ndina mbaapma weleilaa kɨta vat yelavɨtangwuk.

Waagan kaik kat mɨna kwunaka yetɨga lɨga njambwi nyan Jisas nɨn kat tɨga kiyandɨ waa yelavɨka yetɨga lɨga Jisasna mbaapma nɨmbonala ana wan ngu kɨgiyangwuk. Kavle vat apma vat kapma kapma tɨgandɨ. Waagan kaik kat kwunatɨga nɨmbogwinala kɨtamba ana kɨgiyangwuk.
Ngwuk wupma yingweyan njambwi nyan ngwuk kat kɨmbut yiga wun kat manda kat kwangalalaa waagan kat mɨna kwunatɨgangwuk waa yelavɨka tɨgiyandɨ. Ndɨ kat ana inaka kwunalakiyanɨn.
SƗVA SƗVA GODNA SƗ MƗNA KWUSOGA LƗGIYANƗN

Nat nɨmba wwalɨgandi. Yetɨneya vak njambiya kai waa walɨgandi. Ndinai waa vak kɨta vat ana nglaatndɨ. Nat vak yetɨneya vak nat nɨmba kat ana kwunatɨgandɨ. Nat vak yetɨneya vak nat nɨmba kat kavle vak yelɨgandɨ.
Ngwuk ngwutna maawupmba mɨna ke yelavɨka yetɨngwa. Ngwutna maawupmba yetɨngweya vapma yetɨngweyan nat nɨmbana maawui kat mbaa kavle yilangwuk. Wan nɨmba kat apma vapmba yelavɨka yetɨ ngwula.
Stuamba klanjeya wɨmbu kɨgɨnda kɨgiyangwuk. Wan nda kat yanda kava kat maawupmba ke yelavɨka. Wan nda kwowa, kɨgiyangwuk.
Nɨn vɨlɨganɨn. Wan kɨpmamba tɨga nda njambwi nyana nda aywaa tɨga.
Kraistnana mbaapma nyan ana ndɨ wuna ngaymba yaa kɨ ngwula waa wandɨ maas yingweyan wovuna. Ngwuk kat kwindeya nda wana kai wangweya. Wana ngwutna maawupmba yelavɨka wata wagalalɨngweya. Agɨmbangwuk.

Kɨta nyan waagan kat kwilɨnja wimbu kɨgɨnda kan ngwuk kat kwiga ngwuk Kraistna nɨmba wan wɨmbu kɨndɨga kɨlɨgangwuk? Waa wandeyan ngwuk ke kɨngwa. Kɨngwuk mala ngwuk kat waigandɨ. Ngwuk kavle nɨmba ngwuk waa waigandɨ. Kavle nɨmba ngwuk waa ngwuk kat mbaa yelavɨtnadɨ wan nyan.
Nat nyan wun kat wigandɨ. Wan kɨgɨnda God nɨn kat kwidɨ. Ndɨ kat sɨvu kɨlaa kɨweyan wovuna. Nat nyan kavle vatna ke kɨga waa wandeyan ndɨnai waigaa vak manda kat wukiyowun waa waigandɨ.
